  • Method Details

    • open

      void open(Destination destination)
      Specification:
      • requires: None
      • modifies: this
      • effects: Opens the SlidingPopupView. If the SlidingPopupView is already opened then changing the displayed Destination. Does nothing if destination == null.
      Parameters:
      destination - The Destination whose details will be displayed in the popup.

    • close

      void close()
      Specification:
      • requires: None
      • modifies: this
      • effects: Closes the SlidingPopupView. Does nothing if SlidingPopupView is already closed.
